recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It removes a stale/broken reference left behind by the CapabilityStatement.profile move and aligns the REST narrative with the later profile-versus-supportedProfile clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-12829 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Conformance. It requested support for linking profiles to REST resources; the final resolution moved CapabilityStatement.profile inside CapabilityStatement.rest.resource and named it supportedProfile.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 12734. Git commit 3046b26fdb applied the core change by removing the top-level CapabilityStatement.profile row from the CapabilityStatement source spreadsheet and adding CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.supportedProfile plus example content. Current source defines both CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.profile and CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.supportedProfile, and source/fhir.ini preserves an old-path migration mapping from CapabilityStatement.profile to CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.supportedProfile.
additional_context: A pre-existing REST narrative sentence in source/http.html still linked to capabilitystatement-definitions.html#CapabilityStatement.profile. Later FHIR-25462 clarified that CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.profile describes system-wide resource behavior, while CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.supportedProfile describes use-case-specific profiles. Because the REST paragraph discusses incomplete support for resource features and values, the current resource-level profile element is the correct replacement target. Direct FHIR-12829 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community guidance.
reconciliation: Updated source/http.html to link to CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.profile and call it a resource profile. No generated artifacts were edited, and the intentional fhir.ini migration mapping was left unchanged.
source_changes: source/http.html: changed the transactional-integrity paragraph link from capabilitystatement-definitions.html#CapabilityStatement.profile to capabilitystatement-definitions.html#CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.profile, with link text updated from profile to resource profile.
